decision: The V block transposer is replaced by a placement change (no 8-sector buffer). qkd_kv_static_writer VMAP=1 puts V row t in group {t[5:4],t[0]} of stack t[8:7], PC sector {1,0,t[6],t[12:9],t[3:1]}; K is unchanged. Each w16 port k then reads only groups {k,0} (even q) and {k,1} (odd q). Every PC delivers its rows in the controller's EXISTING v_consumer_order (ascending ordinal {t[12:9],t[6],t[3:1]}), one sector every 2nd core edge; the rows t<T are an ordinal prefix. The KV-die V port qkd_pv16_vport is a static 2:1 select of two 4-PC quads with input+output pin registers.
